title: Medical Health Camp Rotaract Club of Kapol

summary: The Medical Health Camp organised by the Rotaract Club of Kapol Vidyanidhi College, in collaboration with our Medical team, received a wonderful response from the community.
description:
The Medical Health Camp organised by the Rotaract Club of Kapol Vidyanidhi College, in collaboration with our Medical team, received a wonderful response from the community. The camp recorded 79 OPD consultations with 25 cataract cases detected and 26 pairs of spectacles distributed free of cost. All necessary referrals, including cataract surgeries, were directed to our Narendra Soni Vision Centre for further care.

Our Rotaractors were actively involved, right from door-to-door canvassing in the underprivileged community to ensuring the smooth conduct of the camp. The presence of Corporator Shri Hemanshu Parikh was also encouraging.

A special appreciation to PP Rtn. Rakesh Shah for arranging the medical van from Bhaktivedanta Hospital.

Grateful to the Rotarians who were present: Rtn. Rakesh Shah, Rtn. Dr. Amola Parikh, Rtn. Prithika Samani

A wonderful example of the Medical and Youth Avenues coming together
